title: Path Sum III
description:
Given a binary tree and `targetSum`, count downward paths whose node values sum to `targetSum`. A path may start and end at any nodes, but it must move from each parent to one of its children.

## Examples

```text
Input: root = [10, 5, -3, 3, 2, null, 11, 3, -2, null, 1], targetSum = 8
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: root = [5, 4, 8, 11, null, 13, 4, 7, 2, null, null, 5, 1], targetSum = 22
Output: 3
```

## Constraints

- The tree has between 0 and 1000 nodes.
- `-10^9 <= Node.val <= 10^9`
- `-1000 <= targetSum <= 1000`
